"""Executable Test 1: for every path in P02's actual checkpoint delta, find every
active prompt whose authorized_paths textually would also permit a write to it
(the broad declared ceiling), then disambiguate using the resolved manifest's
`owns:` mutation-class grant (the actual ownership semantic) to show the class
`python_import_and_qualified_name_codemod_tooling` is P02's alone."""
import fnmatch
import re
import subprocess
import yaml
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(".").resolve()
PROMPT_FILES = sorted(REPO_ROOT.glob("plans_internal/refactor_repo/prompts/P0*.prompt.v3.yaml")) + \
               sorted(REPO_ROOT.glob("plans_internal/refactor_repo/prompts/generated/*.yaml"))

def extract_authorized_paths(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    m = re.search(r"^authorized_paths:\n((?:  - .*\n)+)", text, re.MULTILINE)
    return [line.strip()[2:].strip().strip('"') for line in m.group(1).splitlines()] if m else []

def path_is_authorized(rel_path: str, patterns: list[str]) -> bool:
    for pat in patterns:
        if pat.endswith("/"):
            if rel_path == pat.rstrip("/") or rel_path.startswith(pat):
                return True
        elif "*" in pat:
            if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel_path, pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(Path(rel_path).name, pat):
                return True
        elif rel_path == pat:
            return True
    return False

prompt_auth = {pf.name: extract_authorized_paths(pf) for pf in PROMPT_FILES}

manifest = yaml.safe_load(
    Path("plans_internal/refactor_repo/prompts/resolved/prompt_manifest.resolved.v1.yaml").read_text()
)
owns_by_prompt_id = {k: v.get("owns", []) for k, v in manifest["prompts"].items()}
status_by_prompt_id = {k: v.get("status") for k, v in manifest["prompts"].items()}
filename_to_id = {Path(v["path"]).name: k for k, v in manifest["prompts"].items()}

result = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--short", "--untracked-files=all"],
                         cwd=REPO_ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
changed_paths = []
for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
    p = line[3:].strip()
    if p.startswith("tools/refactor_repo/rewrite_runtime_imports.py") or p.startswith("tests/refactor_repo/codemod/"):
        if p.endswith("/"):
            for f in (REPO_ROOT / p).rglob("*"):
                if f.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in f.parts:
                    changed_paths.append(str(f.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)))
        else:
            changed_paths.append(p)
